# The smallest window any GUI scale gives (a 640x480 window at GUI scale 2 = 320x240):
# - the made-up playlists in Spanish: "7 canciones" and "9 canciones" whole, "♪ 10", "♪ 13" and "♪ 14" where
#   "10 canciones", "13 canciones" and "14 canciones" ended in "…";
# - without the made-up songs and without Spotify (the songs heard lately), the sign-in strip above the songs on two
#   lines that end in a word, not "…": Russian "Войдите в Spotify, чтобы видеть здесь свои песни", Ukrainian
#   "Увійдіть у Spotify, щоб бачити тут свої пісні".
# Why the songs didn't load (now on up to three lines) needs a Spotify account whose loading fails, so it isn't here.
# Run it: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=<branch> -f size=640x480 -f script=.github/checks/fit-fixes2.txt

cmd time set noon
look 0 -20
sleep 6
guiscale 2
set demoMode true
set libraryView GRID

lang es_es
sleep 15
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
# The library opens on the liked songs; Tab goes on to the playlists
key tab
sleep 3
shot fit2-playlists-es
close

# (The Russian and Ukrainian sign-in strip needs the demo song off, which checks never do; LibraryFitTest covers it.)
